public_recovery.scope: publisher host policy; not an executable wire schema

last_known_good.store: repository immutable release under site-recovery/ tag namespace
last_known_good.preserved_payload: original Pages tar byte sequence and SHA-256; upload wrapper and current-run artifact ID may differ
last_known_good.retention: retain current and predecessor without time expiry; remove older snapshots only after successor promotion and explicit unreferenced cleanup under publisher lock

writer.journal: protected pages-state branch; append-only events, fast-forward commits; not a Pages source branch
writer.unresolved_intent: block new deploy and restore until control-plane and public-identity reconciliation

publication_pointers.current_publication: current served deployment receipt and latest public re-smoke, updated to the new restoration deployment ID after recovery
publication_pointers.last_known_good: immutable original payload/source/public-smoke lineage, preserved across restoration
publication_pointers.interrupted_promotion: re-confirm journal/API/public identity and run fresh public smoke before completing LKG promotion

restore_guard: current journal transaction equals failed candidate
public build and asset identity equals failed candidate
no newer deployment or external writer
saved LKG payload and evidence verify
public_recovery.first_failure_without_lkg: BootstrapFailed; no automatic site delete or unverified maintenance payload; explicit corrected candidate under same writer
public_recovery.restoration: verify saved tar, upload it into current recovery run, deploy, then repeat public smoke and artifact identity checks
public_recovery.result: original candidate and original workflow remain failed even after successful restoration; persist incident and re-smoke evidence
